title: Hic Alexander Responsum accepit usque quo Alexander
description: This Latin legend is marked on the manuscript of the Tabula Peutingeriana in the general vicinity of the city of Alexandria Eschate. Posed as a rhetorical question, this text may corroborate a story related in the Alexander Romance relating to Alexander's seeming insatiable appetite for territorial conquest.
names: Hic Alexander Responsum accepit usque quo Alexander
